page.overview:
Who is Jake's Family?

Jake's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Jake from The Real Jake, the second story of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

Jake was the only son of Evan and Roxanne. He is the protagonist of The Real Jake and throughout the Stitchwraith Stingers saga. After death, his soul inhabits Simon and, later on, his mask will later be used by Phineas Taggart to create the Stitchwraith.

Evan was Roxanne's husband and the father of Jake. He is a military soldier who is drafted and serving out overseas. He is also the secret identity of Simon, the animatronic doll that sits in Jake's closet. He sadly dies from an IED detonation in the vehicle he was in out at sea, and it's kept a secret from Jake.

Roxanne was Evan's wife and the mother of Jake. She is briefly mentioned in the story. She died when Jake was young. Due to Evan being overseas, Margie is hired to take care of Jake instead.
